title: bn254-gt-dlp: stored-prefix ECM and PGF descent2^94.524993747

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-gt-dlp target, the precise algorithm of proof.md, field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md and STORAGE.md returns x with g^x=z with success at least0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under H1-H4, H-EA, H-R (finite actual relation spanning), H-X (finite block controllability/observability), H-FFT, the conditional node PGF envelope H5(alpha=1/2), boot single-trial smoothness, and H-SEP(the per-curve ECM factor-extraction probability is at least one half the modeled order-hit probability), with their support and extrapolation limits disclosed. Expected total classical work is at most1+(K/2^64)2^95.877973860<2^94.524993747 units, C=20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents. All preprocessing, advice construction, failed trials, aborts, arithmetic, transfers, verification and output are charged once for this target. The independent64-bit run gate fails unless v<K=7221578305790754719, the least K with (K/2^64)x0.996213>=0.39. Opened-run success is at least0.996213; expected two-log work is at most2^95.805191 units. Only kept-relation splitting is metered at2^112 units, with a doubled split row paying bounded per-schedule debits; both logarithms retain their combined phase meter at2^116. No numeric whole-run work bound is asserted; all other rows are expected upper bounds under the stated hypotheses. The calculation charges split-only and combined-log meter losses plus recursive, node-counter and repeat losses. This is an expected-work claim; there is no negative-binomial lazy-cofactor discount, DISC confidence allowance, whole-ball boot waiting-time assertion or fixed-family universal positivity premise. Nothing is amortized over other targets. Analytic exploratory claim; small experiments do not prove production success or price bounds. Stored-prefix ECM uses deterministic endpoint queries on a divisibility chain, preserves the original factor partition and H-SEP, and charges first-pass storage and every required gcd. Exact scaled partition checks and production extrapolation limits are in DESCENT.md. ECM-only cell counts include the exact base-primitivity and ordinary-ideal fraction; the exact post-stripping residual bound is enforced before T-priced schedules. Perfect powers and both final ECM gcds are retained as specified in DESCENT.md. RANK-BRIDGE.md makes finite relation spanning distinct from class-number/map assumptions and gives the conditional randomized solver bound. ADAPTIVE.md retains28multilevel recursive toy runs and all censors, with pre-entry failure/sibling strata; no uniform production transfer is claimed proved. Node failure is bounded by the analytic count-tail plus sequential-availability inequality P(fail)<=P(M<k)+psi^k in THRESHOLD-REPAIR.md, not PGF(psi). The fixed repaired radii and all downstream losses are recomputed; no count/descendant joint-independence or new joint-domination hypothesis is added. Peak memory is below2^100bytes and remains supplementary.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the field, collection, filtering and cost-ledger arithmetic, including revised PGF-envelope descent and finite ECM-separation assumptions; rebuild returns rounded draft declarations. Arithmetic passes do not establish production hypotheses. part=pgf recomputes alpha=.5 PGF envelopes at psi=0..0.8 step .01 on all862 downward-rounded raw-mu toy observations; part=porttoy redoes an exact whole ball or parent/child/control from fixed seeds. These are scoped toy checks, not production proofs. Default{} also replays all862 PGF observations. part=bw config0..3 replays seven-pad positive/negative diagnostics; part=adaptive_stats recomputes all171entered-node PGF strata; part=adaptive,side,root_seed,order regenerates bounded recursive whole-ball evidence. These do not establish production relation saturation or uniform conditional transfer. Default also replays all171adaptive observations with downward-rounded rawmu; censored root outcomes remain unknown. part=threshold verifies the judge counterexample and existing171 count tails for the corrected analytic inequality; it adds no empirical joint-law claim.
